title: Summer boat and resort jobs; Lake Delavan and Fritz Nielsen
summary: They mention Lake Michigan boats, Delavan, Wisconsin, and the amateur pianist Fritz Nielsen.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Now, in the work around Chicago, the summertime work drew some of these men onto the boats. Do you ever ride the boats across Lake Michigan? Boats that had five- and six-piece bands?
No. I know they did that at that point. I didn't.

Both Bix and McPartland, whom we've mentioned, worked those boats. And apparently so did Brunus on occasion. Now, this may have been their first contact with Brunus. And it would be about 23, 24 in the summers of those years.

They also played at Lake Delavan. In Wisconsin. Well, Condon and McPartland. Oh, yes. And a wonderful amateur. We always thought of him as an amateur, Fritz Nielsen, a pianist. It's probable that Fritz was the best of the Chicago pianists.
Did that be in those years? Yes. Or earliest 20s?
Early 20s. The Chicago pianists were not very good. The white pianists weren't very good.
